description.description: The meta bug's description, in Markdown.

summary.description: Only when asked: the meta bug's summary, "[meta] …".

answer.description: Only when revising it after the user's comment: what you changed, and for what you didn't, why and what you checked.

product.description: Only when the user asks for another product.

component.description: Only when the user asks for another component.

blocks.description: Only when the user asks: the bugs it should also block.

feedback.description: Problems with the tools or inputs you used, one entry per problem.
